purpose: Validate representative Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment ownership JOIN fixtures against the B-1 frozen EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO production source, including one independent MissionType 77 cross-check and explicit scope-boundary probes, without reopening source discovery.

fixtureSelectionPolicy.goal: Exercise all four EquipmentType values represented by the early frozen Hero Stage 5-2 output and include a cross-source fixture whose Equipment ID is independently exposed by a verified MissionType 77 record.
fixtureSelectionPolicy.selectionReason: EquipmentType is not an ownership JOIN field, but covering weapon/armor/headgear/accessory fixtures demonstrates that the frozen resolver does not vary by display equipment category.
fixtureSelectionPolicy.reusePolicy: Reuse already validated Hero Stage 5-2 generated ownership records instead of rereading the 1.4MB EquipmentInfo blob. The direct source semantics were already fully validated 167/167 in B-1; B-2 tests representative manifestations and independent corroboration.

negativeBoundaryFixtures.reason: General Equipment eligibility is outside Stage B and must be rejected before SkillHero ownership evaluation.
Equipment 2013 is explicitly outside the frozen 167 exclusive-equipment population.

validationRules: Each positive fixture equipmentId must belong to acquisitionClass exclusive-equipment.
Each positive fixture must preserve PathType 46 as population-support evidence.
Each positive fixture ownerResolver must be ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero and ownerHeroId must exactly equal the fixture canonical heroId.
The four positive fixtures together must cover EquipmentType 0, 1, 2, and 3.
Leon Equipment 416 must match the verified MissionType 77 Param1 Equipment 416 cross-validation fixture.
Description owner-name presence may corroborate a verified pair but must not create or repair a pair.
General Equipment and Equipment 2013 must be rejected before ownership resolver evaluation.
No heuristic source and no alternate production resolver may contribute a fixture result.

admissionDecision.fixtureContradictionPolicy: Any mismatch between a positive fixture and an admitted independent cross-check blocks B-2 and reopens B-1 source investigation. No mismatch is permitted to be silently patched.
admissionDecision.downstreamOnPass: B-3 may generate the full 167-record canonical ownership edge set from the frozen EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO source.

completion: B-2 is complete when four EquipmentType-diverse positive fixtures resolve by the frozen SkillHero source, Leon 416 agrees with MissionType 77, excluded populations are rejected before resolver evaluation, and contradiction/heuristic counts are zero.
